title: Frieza’s Nightmare 2.0
intro: My first custom Parallel Quest, rebuilt from the ground up. Frieza’s Nightmare began in 2022 as a what-if quest. Version 2.0 goes bigger and darker, and this time the path is yours to choose.
image_alt: A furious, battle-damaged Frieza, from the Frieza’s Nightmare 2.0 teaser.

progress.item: Old enemies return from the shadows.
A new threat no one saw coming.
Choose your path. Your choices change the fight.
Frieza’s worst nightmare is just beginning.

note: No release date yet. How 2.0 will be released is still being decided. Version 1.7 is free to play now.
coming_note: 2.0 trailer and release details: shared when it’s ready.

hype: My first custom Parallel Quest, and the one that started it all. A hard-difficulty gauntlet where the fights keep coming and Frieza has to survive every one.
Who you face next depends on who you defeat first.
Version 1.7 is free to play now. Version 2.0 is being rebuilt from the ground up.
